metadata.name: 浙江省瑞安市城区 OSM 地理底图样本
notes: Actual OpenStreetMap geographic features, not synthetic geometry.
Selection bbox retrieves complete geometries, including portions outside selected extent; clip rendering to selection_bbox.
Only selected feature categories and map extent; not a complete navigation dataset.
No realtime traffic, flood depth, shelter status, road safety or live closures.
Preserve attribution and ODbL license when distributing the extracted database.
